messages:
Sara - Sales: Hey team — HealthInsure POC asked for SOC 2 artifacts, ISO scope excerpt, and a signed pen-test authorization letter. They want this by EOD Friday. Can security/SRE confirm what we can share and the handoff method?

Alex - Security: Hi — we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II excerpt, ISO 27001 scope statement, and our pen-test authorization template. HIPAA note: they asked about BA status; we are not a BA but will provide a controls mapping. Which exact docs did they list?

Sara - Sales: Their list: SOC2 Type II last 12 months (redacted), ISO scope statement, pen-test auth letter permitting their vendor to scan our STAGING only, KMS/key custody summary, and network diagram. They prefer SFTP but will accept an Azure SAS link.

Jordan - SolutionsEng: Quick notes — do NOT give prod creds. Recommend a dedicated POC tenant or isolated staging overlay. If they need to run external scans we need an allowlist window. Also need to confirm whether they want app-layer testing (auth bypass, fuzzing) vs just network port scans.

Eli - SRE: I can spin up a temporary POC namespace and short-lived upload account. For uploads we support SFTP + scp and an Azure blob SAS. Example scp for vendor: `scp evidence.zip poc@upload.redwood-inference.com:/incoming/healthinsure/` — I'll attach rotation and removal policy.

Alex - Security: Pen-test letter requirements: legal company name, explicit scope (hostnames/IP ranges), allowed tests, blackout rules (no social engineering), time window, and emergency kill/contact. I'll paste a minimal template below for legal to sign.

Alex - Security: ```PenTest Authorization (template)
Company: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Customer: HealthInsure, Inc.
Scope: staging.poc.healthinsure.redwood-inference.com (10.240.5.0/24) and listed staging hostnames
Allowed tests: external network scans, application layer (no physical/social engineering), credentialed scans only if agreed
Exclusions: production systems, customer data stores, any human-targeted phishing
Window: 2026-05-01 00:00 UTC to 2026-05-03 23:59 UTC
Emergency contact: security@redwood.com / +1-555-0100
Signature: Authorized signatory, Redwood Inference, Inc.
```

Jordan - SolutionsEng: Also note for the POC we can enable a variant with limited logging/retention. We should include the retention SLA in the bundle (e.g., 30 days for logs).

AuditBot: Ticket CPL-842 created for 'HealthInsure POC evidence bundle' — upload deadline 2026-05-07. Assigned: Alex, Eli.

Sara - Sales: Thanks. Alex / Eli — can you confirm by tomorrow morning you'll deliver the redacted SOC2 excerpt, signed pen-test letter (or draft for legal), ISO scope, KMS summary, and the upload link/creds? I need to confirm timeline with HealthInsure.

Alex - Security: Confirmed. I'll prepare the SOC2 extract and draft the pen-test authorization and route to Legal for signature by 2026-04-30 COB. Will include KMS diagram and key rotation policy. Link will be SFTP + Azure SAS.

Eli - SRE: I'll provision the POC tenant and create the temp upload account by tomorrow AM. Will include allowlist window instructions and an automated teardown script.

Sara - Sales: Perfect — last add: they asked for a short one-pager on encryption at rest and KMS custody. Alex, will that be part of the bundle?

Alex - Security: Yes — one-page KMS summary + admin list and rotation cadence. I'll drop it in the upload.

Sara - Sales: Awesome, thank you all :thumbsup: — I'll update HealthInsure and set a brief sync if Legal needs to be looped in for signature.
__notes: Generated Slack thread for a sales/compliance coordination conversation. No title field per agents.md.
